framework.name: UAE Information Assurance Standard
framework.source: UAE INFORMATION ASSURANCE STANDARD.pdf, the "Relevant Threats and Vulnerabilities" list of each control objective

families.name: Information Systems Acquisition, Development and Maintenance

objectives.title: Entity Context and Leadership
objectives.objective: To establish leadership and a management framework to initiate and control the implementation of information security within the entity.
objectives.performance_indicator: Percentage of tasks or milestones from the information security implementation plan that have been completed.

controls.title: Understanding the Entity and its Context
Roles and Responsibilities for Information Security

objectives.title: Information Security Policy
objectives.objective: To provide a framework and management direction and support for information security in the entity, in accordance with business requirements and relevant laws and regulations.
objectives.performance_indicator: Percentage of information security policies reviewed as per defined frequency.

objectives.title: Support
objectives.objective: To provide sufficient resources, appropriate communication, and documentation for the entity’s Information Security Program.
objectives.performance_indicator: Percentage of incidents that are caused by a lack of qualified resources for information security. Percentage of projects with completed information security risk assessments.

objectives.title: Information Security Risk Management Policy
objectives.objective: To establish a formal information risk management framework for managing an entity’s information security risks by establishing the context, performing risk assessment, implementing risk treatments, and monitoring their implementation.
objectives.performance_indicator: Trend in the number of occurrences where the risk assessment has not been performed, reviewed, or updated as planned.

objectives.title: Information Security Risk Assessment
objectives.objective: To identify, analyze, and evaluate the information security risks the entity is facing.
objectives.performance_indicator: Percentage of risk assessments that were completed within the planned or scheduled timeframe.

objectives.title: Information Security Risk Treatment
objectives.objective: To identify and plan appropriate risk treatment for the risks that have been assessed.
objectives.performance_indicator: Percentage of identified risks that have been successfully treated within the planned timeframe.

objectives.title: Ongoing Information Security Risk Management
objectives.objective: To ensure that the risk management process is communicated, consulted, and monitored.
objectives.performance_indicator: Percentage of cases in the past year where the information security risk assessment and/or risk treatment was not updated as scheduled, despite significant changes occurring.

controls.title: Information Security Risk Assessment Review and Update

objectives.title: Awareness and Training Policy
objectives.objective: To maintain an awareness and training policy outlining the approach to identifying relevant topics, enrollment of stakeholders, and documentation of activities.
objectives.performance_indicator: The trend in the number of employees that have not successfully participated in the awareness and training program.

objectives.title: Awareness and Training Planning
objectives.objective: To ensure that all person(s) carrying out work affecting information security are sufficiently aware of information security requirements and controls and are adequately trained to execute their responsibilities.
objectives.performance_indicator: Percentage of actions (planned training, participation in conferences, etc.) that have not been carried out as planned.

objectives.title: Security Training
objectives.objective: To ensure that all personnel who are assigned responsibilities in information security are competent to perform the required tasks.
objectives.performance_indicator: Percentage of identified information security training requirements that have been met with satisfactory results.

objectives.title: Security Awareness
objectives.objective: To foster security awareness of the workforce within the entity.
objectives.performance_indicator: Percentage of identified information security awareness campaigns that have been successfully implemented.

objectives.title: Prior to Employment
objectives.objective: To ensure that employees, contractors, and third party users understand their responsibilities, and are suitable for the roles they are considered for.
objectives.performance_indicator: Percentage of new employees and contractors that have been fully screened and approved in accordance with company policies prior to starting work. Percentage of employees, contractors, and third parties who read and accepted relevant information security policies.

objectives.title: During Employment
objectives.objective: To ensure that employees, contractors, and third-party users are aware of information security threats and concerns, their responsibilities and liabilities, and are equipped to support organizational security policy in the course of their normal work, and to reduce the risk of human error.
objectives.performance_indicator: Percentage of employees that participated in information security awareness training.

controls.title: Notification and Communication of Security Policies

objectives.title: Termination or Change of Employment
objectives.objective: To ensure that employees, contractors and third party users exit an entity or change employment in an orderly manner.
objectives.performance_indicator: Percentage of employees, contractors, and third-party user accounts that are blocked after termination. Percentage of employees, contractors, and third-party users accounts whose profiles are modified based on role change.

controls.title: Responsibilities after termination or change of employment

objectives.title: Compliance with Information Security Legal Requirements
objectives.objective: To avoid breaches of any information security legal, statutory, regulatory, or contractual obligations.
objectives.performance_indicator: Number of instances where regulatory fines are imposed on the entity due to non- compliance.

controls.title: Data Protection and Privacy of Personal Information

objectives.title: Compliance with Information Policies and Standards
objectives.objective: To ensure compliance with the entity’s information security policies and standards.
objectives.performance_indicator: Percentage of compliance with the control requirements in this standard.

objectives.title: Information Systems Audit Considerations
objectives.objective: To maximize the effectiveness of the information systems audit process
objectives.performance_indicator: Percentage of audits interrupted due to operational or security issues.

controls.title: Protection of information systems during audit testing

objectives.title: Performance Evaluation Policy
objectives.objective: To maintain a performance evaluation policy outlining the approach to measure and evaluate the effectiveness of the information security of the entity.
objectives.performance_indicator: Percentage of established KPIs that are actively measured and tracked.

objectives.title: Performance Evaluation
objectives.objective: To ensure that information security performance is measured, analyzed and evaluated.
objectives.performance_indicator: Percentage of all those non-conformities that have been detected and not resolved within the time frame planned.

objectives.title: Improvement
objectives.objective: To correct nonconformities with this standard and to continually improve the information security program in place.
objectives.performance_indicator: Number of all non-conformities that have been detected and not resolved within the time frame planned.

objectives.title: Information Asset Management Policy
objectives.objective: To maintain an information asset management policy outlining the procedures to identify, classify, and handle information assets.
objectives.performance_indicator: Extent of asset management policy enforcement across the entity.

objectives.title: Responsibility for Assets
objectives.objective: To achieve and maintain appropriate protection of the entity’s information assets.
objectives.performance_indicator: Percentage of employees who have authorized access to information systems only after signing an acknowledgment that they have read and understood rules of behavior. Percentage of entity’s information assets without assigned owners or responsible parties.

controls.title: Inventory of Information and other Associated Assets
Acceptable Use of Information and other Associated Assets

objectives.title: Information Protection
objectives.objective: To ensure that information receives an appropriate level of protection.
objectives.performance_indicator: Percentage of information assets that are correctly classified and handled.

objectives.title: Storage Media
objectives.objective: To ensure authorized disclosure, modification, removal, or destruction of information on storage media.
objectives.performance_indicator: Percentage of information assets that are not disposed securely.

controls.title: Secure Re-use or Disposal of Storage Media

objectives.title: User Endpoint Devices
objectives.objective: To protect information against the risks introduced by using user endpoint devices.
objectives.performance_indicator: Percentage of mobile devices given access to company resources without any MDM solution. Percentage of endpoint devices that have full disk encryption enabled.

objectives.title: Physical and Environmental Security Policy
objectives.objective: To maintain a physical and environmental security policy that outlines the security requirements of physical areas and equipment.
objectives.performance_indicator: Extent of physical and environmental security policy deployment and adoption across the entity.

objectives.title: Secure Areas
objectives.objective: To prevent unauthorized physical access, damage, and interference to the entity’s premises and information.
objectives.performance_indicator: Percentage of resolved/closed corrective items identified from periodic physical security site surveys. Percentage of physical access reviews conducted as per the defined frequency.

controls.title: Protecting Against External and Environmental Threats

objectives.title: Equipment Security
objectives.objective: To prevent loss, damage, theft or compromise of assets and interruption to the entity’s activities.
objectives.performance_indicator: Percentage of performed checks that revealed unauthorized movement of information assets or other information security-related issues. Percentage of planned maintenance activities for supporting utilities that were not completed as scheduled.

controls.title: Secure Disposal or Re-Use of Equipment
Clear Desk and Clear Screen Policy

objectives.title: Operational Procedures and Responsibilities
objectives.objective: To ensure the correct and secure operation of information systems.
objectives.performance_indicator: Percentage of information systems that meet all operational information security requirements.

controls.title: Separation of Development, Test and Operational Facilities

objectives.title: Monitoring
objectives.objective: To detect, prevent and correct the misuse of systems and information that could impact the security of an entity.
objectives.performance_indicator: Percentage of critical systems and applications that have audit logging enabled.

objectives.title: Threat and Vulnerability Management
objectives.objective: To provide awareness of the threat environment and mitigate risks from the exploitation of published or identified technical vulnerabilities.
objectives.performance_indicator: Percentage of identified vulnerabilities mitigated within the acceptable time periods as defined in security requirements.

objectives.title: Cryptography and Key Management
objectives.objective: To protect the confidentiality, authenticity or integrity of information by cryptographic means.
objectives.performance_indicator: Percentage of systems containing valuable/sensitive data for which suitable cryptographic controls have been fully implemented.

controls.title: Data at Rest and in Motion

objectives.title: Network Security Management
objectives.objective: To ensure the protection of information in networks and the security of the supporting infrastructure.
objectives.performance_indicator: Percentage of information systems that meet all network security management requirements.

objectives.title: Identity and Access Management
objectives.objective: To maintain an identity and access management policy to control access to information and other associated assets.
objectives.performance_indicator: Extent of identity and access management policy deployment and adoption across the entity.

objectives.title: User Access Management
objectives.objective: To enforce authorized user access and to prevent unauthorized access to information systems.
objectives.performance_indicator: Percentage of identities that are managed by centralized identity management system. The total number of access requests processed within a specified timeframe. The number of unauthorized access attempts detected and prevented. Percentage of accuracy in access provisioning and deprovisioning. Number of delayed access change requests and the average time taken to action them.

objectives.title: Secure authentication and authorization
objectives.objective: To ensure a user or an entity is securely authenticated and authorized, when access to systems, applications and services is granted.
objectives.performance_indicator: Percentage of accounts that have MFA enabled. Percentage of accounts that have SSO enabled. Percentage of successful authentication attempts relative to the total number of authentication attempts.

objectives.title: Authentication Information
objectives.objective: To ensure proper authentication and prevent failures of authentication processes.
objectives.performance_indicator: Percentage of systems compliant with the entity’s password policy.

objectives.title: Third Party Security Policy
objectives.objective: To maintain a third party security policy covering the security of acquired services.
objectives.performance_indicator: Extent of third party security policy deployment and adoption across the entity.

objectives.title: Management of Third Party and Supply Chain Risks
objectives.objective: To manage the information security risks associated with the use of supplier’s products or services.
objectives.performance_indicator: Frequency of information security incidents involving third parties.

controls.title: Third party security assessment during onboarding
Managing information security in the ICT supply chain
Addressing information security within third party agreements
Monitoring, review, and change management of third party services

objectives.title: Information Systems Acquisition, Development and Maintenance Policy
objectives.objective: To maintain an information systems acquisition, development and maintenance policy covering the security of information systems throughout its lifecycle.
objectives.performance_indicator: Extent of information systems acquisition, development and maintenance policy enforcement and adoption across the entity.

controls.title: Information Systems Acquisition, Development and Maintenance Policy

objectives.title: Security Requirements of Information Systems
objectives.objective: To ensure that security requirements are established and functionally integrated into information systems.
objectives.performance_indicator: Percentage of systems implementations accepted into service with all security requirements implemented.

objectives.title: Secure software development
objectives.objective: To ensure the software is written securely thereby reducing the number of potential information security vulnerabilities in the software.
objectives.performance_indicator: Instances where critical security vulnerabilities were not fixed before deployment of code into a production environment.

controls.title: Access Control to Program Source Code

objectives.title: Secure testing and deployment
objectives.objective: To validate if information security requirements are met when applications or code are deployed to the production environment, protect the production environment and data from compromise by development and test activities, and preserve information security when executing changes.
objectives.performance_indicator: Number of cases where the change management processes have not been executed correctly.

controls.title: Security testing in development and acceptance

objectives.title: Information Security Incident Management Policy
objectives.objective: To maintain an information security incident management policy that can provide the framework for the detection, reporting, and treatment of incidents.
objectives.performance_indicator: Extent of information security incident management policy deployment and adoption across the entity.

objectives.title: Management of Information Security Incidents and Improvements
objectives.objective: To ensure a consistent and effective approach to the management of information security incidents.
objectives.performance_indicator: The percentage of security incidents reported within the required timeframe, classified, and handled according to the incident classification policy.

objectives.title: ICT readiness for business continuity
objectives.objective: To ensure the availability of the organization’s information and other associated assets during disruption.
objectives.performance_indicator: Percentage of organizational units with documented information continuity plans, regular testing and business recovery is meeting expectations, ensuring minimal downtime.

objectives.title: Testing, Maintaining and Reassessing Plans
objectives.objective: To ensure the effectiveness of the information systems continuity plans and that they are always up to date.
objectives.performance_indicator: Percentage of information systems that went through annual testing.

controls.title: Testing, Maintaining and Re-Assessing Information Systems Continuity Plans
